name: jago-office-management
description: Jago Corporation PLC - Office Management & Sales System (Windows 11 64-bit Desktop Application)

scripts.web:build: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path www; Copy-Item -Path index.html, index.php, api.php, manifest.json, sw.js, .htaccess, _redirects, netlify.toml -Destination www/ -Force; Copy-Item -Path css, js, data -Destination www/ -Recurse -Force"
scripts.build:exe: npm run web:build && npx electron-builder --win portable nsis --x64
scripts.cap:sync: npm run web:build && npx cap sync android

author: Jago Corporation PLC
